title: Deletes everything on server
description: rm -rf / will recursively delete ALL files on the entire server. This is irreversible.

title: Insecure permissions
description: chmod 777 gives read, write and execute to everyone including other users.

title: Disk cloning command
description: dd can completely overwrite disk content if wrong device is specified.

title: Formats a disk
description: mkfs formats and erases everything on a disk partition.

title: Deletes database objects
description: This SQL command permanently deletes a table or entire database.

title: Writing directly to disk device
description: Writing directly to /dev/sdX can corrupt disk data.

title: Server availability impact
description: This command can immediately stop or reboot the server.
